description.value:
Trigger You successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.qm7xptMSozAinnPS]{Arrest a Fall}, or you fall on a creature or on a surface and do not take any falling damage.

You can use your aerobatic movements to always be on the move. When you take this feat, you treat falls a 25 feet shorter if it is lower than any other sources of reducing fall damage.

When you meet the trigger and use this action, you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} off a surface you come into contact with or are adjacent to, or a creature you fall on. If you fall more than the length of your Fly speed or land speed, you can make a Long Jump instead. You can choose to hover in space at the end of your Leap if you are in the air instead of falling.
